item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
First public release of Still, a menu bar app for screenshots and screen recordings.

  • Area, window and fullscreen captures, with a card in the corner to save, copy or edit
  • Backgrounds, arrows, text, numbered steps and redaction
  • Copy Text reads the text in a capture on your Mac
  • Records the screen to mp4, with system audio and the microphone if you turn them on

Needs macOS 27 on Apple Silicon.
